records.name: Virginia AAM Smart Airspace Program
records.short_description: Statewide advanced-air-mobility program connecting vertiport nodes at Roanoke, Virginia Tech, and Blackstone.
records.overview: The Virginia Department of Aviation identifies Smart Airspace as a statewide advanced-air-mobility initiative with vertiport nodes at Roanoke, Virginia Tech Transportation Institute, and Blackstone. Textron reported a September 2026 uncrewed-aircraft demonstration between the Virginia Tech and Blackstone nodes. The program is represented without a single point because its infrastructure spans multiple sites; the agency is headquartered in Richmond. Published diagrams do not establish that every route or vertiport is available for public operations.
